$comment: Satnam registrar handshake. One fetch tells an agent how to interact with the registrar. Status fields are truthful: an endpoint marked gated is implemented but disabled until the operator enables it, and MUST NOT be treated as live.

birth.status_detail: Implemented and tested. Default-off; returns 501 live_requires_authorization until the operator enables it. Authentication is required and unsigned or replayed requests are rejected.

response.lineage: role plus parent reference and birth depth

scan.status_detail: Implemented with SUN verification, counter monotonicity and replay rejection. Behind the issuer flag, default-off.

identity_model.note: The same four roles describe human groups and agent families; the two sides mirror each other. Not all stewards, adults, or offspring are agents. A Bot-Mother-birthed identity is an adult; its creations are offspring; a bot family is stewarded by a human.

flows.human: Family Foundry: claims names and founds the family or business identity
flows.agent: Bot-Mother: births agent identities into the same mirrored role structure

rate_limits.on_exceed: rate-limit response with retry delay; flagging, not permanent blocking
